description: Shell script for testing Git upload-pack ref-in-want behavior, including repository setup, fetch command generation, and various test cases for ref handling and namespace scenarios.

methods.name: get_actual_refs
methods.description: Extracts actual refs from output using sed and test-tool pkt-line unpack.

methods.name: get_actual_commits
methods.description: Processes output to get commit hashes, verifies pack, and sorts commits.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Runs get_actual_refs and get_actual_commits, compares with expected outputs.

methods.name: write_command
methods.description: Outputs a command string and object format based on test_oid algo.

methods.name: write_fetch_command
methods.description: Constructs a fetch command with want-ref, want, and have lines, formatted for test-tool pkt-line.

methods.name: inconsistency
methods.description: Simulates server ref inconsistency by editing server response script.
